description: Retrieve WHO health data for a specific indicator, optionally filtered by country and year range. Returns values for up to 194 countries spanning multiple decades. Official UN member state reporting data.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. "USA", "DEU", "BRA", "JPN"). Omit for all countries

indicator.description: WHO indicator code (e.g. "WHOSIS_000001" for life expectancy, "MDG_0000000001" for under-5 mortality). Get codes from who.indicators

limit.description: Number of data points to return, max 100 (default 20)

name: who.health.data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: WHO Health Data by Indicator
